coverage_gate.measurement_note: gcov-only hand-written C/H coverage. Generated Parser/parser.c and Python/Python-ast.c are recorded as raw generated patch lines but excluded from the executable denominator, matching the generated-artifact treatment for parser/AST outputs.

no_modification_clauses_pinned: PEP 634 uses soft keywords and standard-library metadata additions; existing identifier use, namedtuple behavior, dataclass behavior, and ordinary grammar compilation should remain stable.

mutants.runner_note: Crash-isolating per-test fallback preserved P2P measurement for mutants that abort the aggregate interpreter.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > Overview and Terminology
The Standard Library
tests.public_surface: keyword.issoftkeyword(), keyword.iskeyword(), collections.namedtuple.__match_args__, dataclasses.dataclass generated __match_args__, and match class-pattern use of those public attributes.
tests.rationale: PEP 634 introduced match/case/_ as soft keywords and required namedtuple/dataclass integration through __match_args__; the test observes those public APIs and verifies non-init dataclass fields do not become positional pattern arguments.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > Class Patterns
tests.public_surface: Class patterns against builtin int and a public int subclass.
tests.rationale: The class-pattern contract permits single positional subpatterns for builtin self-matching types and subclasses that inherit the match-self flag; the test validates both without inspecting implementation flags.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > Sequence Patterns
Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > Mapping Patterns
tests.public_surface: match statements over list, str, bytes, bytearray, and dict values.
tests.rationale: PEP 634 excludes string-like objects from sequence patterns, requires fixed-length sequence patterns to reject extra items, and requires mapping patterns to match dict and mapping subjects even when unrelated extra keys are present.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > Class Patterns
tests.public_surface: User-defined class __match_args__ and compile-time validation of duplicate keyword attributes in class patterns.
tests.rationale: Class patterns must translate positional subpatterns through __match_args__ and reject duplicate keyword attributes; both are documented class-pattern semantics visible through normal compile()/match behavior.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > Literal Patterns
Syntax and Semantics > The Match Statement > Guards
Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > AS Patterns
Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > Capture Patterns
tests.public_surface: match statements using singleton literals, guards, AS patterns, and capture patterns.
tests.rationale: The test pins identity matching for None, normal truthiness for guards, and the required name binding effects of AS and capture patterns through direct program results.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > The Match Statement > Irrefutable case blocks
Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > Capture Patterns
Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > OR Patterns
Syntax and Semantics > Patterns > Wildcard Pattern
tests.public_surface: compile(), symtable.symtable(), and match statement syntax validation.
tests.rationale: PEP 634 makes non-final irrefutable cases illegal, forbids duplicate capture names and inconsistent OR-pattern bindings, and specifies that the wildcard does not bind a local name.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > The Match Statement > Match Semantics
tests.public_surface: ast.Match AST construction, ast.fix_missing_locations(), and compile() validation.
tests.rationale: An AST Match node without cases is not a valid match statement; compile() must reject it rather than accepting an impossible runtime form.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > Patterns
Appendix A -- Full Grammar
tests.public_surface: compile() of valid and invalid match/case source snippets spanning literal, capture, wildcard, value, group, sequence, mapping, class, OR, AS, guard, and subject-expression grammar forms.
tests.rationale: This F2P coverage selector exercises the documented PEP 634 grammar through public source compilation only; it checks accepted forms compile and rejected forms raise SyntaxError without depending on parser internals.

requirement_sections: Syntax and Semantics > Overview and Terminology
tests.public_surface: keyword.iskeyword() and ordinary Python assignments using match, case, and _ as names.
tests.rationale: PEP 634 uses soft keywords, so unrelated programs must continue to use these words as ordinary identifiers outside pattern syntax.

requirement_sections: The Standard Library
tests.public_surface: collections.namedtuple attribute, index, defaults, _asdict(), and _fields behavior outside pattern matching.
tests.rationale: The PEP adds pattern-matching metadata to namedtuple but should not change the established tuple-like and attribute behavior of namedtuple instances.

requirement_sections: The Standard Library
tests.public_surface: dataclasses.dataclass generated __init__, defaults, init=False fields, repr, and constructor TypeError behavior outside pattern matching.
tests.rationale: The PEP adds dataclass __match_args__ support while preserving the existing dataclass initialization and representation contracts.

requirement_sections: Appendix A -- Full Grammar
tests.public_surface: ast.parse(), compile(), exec(), and ordinary if/for/function grammar.
tests.rationale: Adding match/case grammar must not perturb unrelated existing grammar or AST compilation paths.
